verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows embedding-provider integrations (OpenAI, VoyageAI, OpenCLIP), Hugging Face dataset access, and an 'AI coding agent' plugin, but contains no mention of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or any maintained first-class RAG/agent-framework connector. This axis clearly applies to a vector database aimed at ML engineers, so absent evidence it is 'none' rather than 'na'.
